title: Eval Result
description: Output of an Eval-as-MCP adversarial pass on a conversation context. Implements the CLAIMS / COUNTEREXAMPLE / CONTRADICTIONS / GAPS pattern as a structured return value.

conversation_id.description: Identifier for the conversation being evaluated

triggered_at_turn.description: Turn identifier where the eval fired

streak_turns.description: Turn IDs that incremented the streak

claims.description: Assertions made by the agent that the eval is testing

counterexample.description: Cases or facts that contradict or challenge the agent's claims

contradictions.description: Internal contradictions within the conversation (e.g., agent's earlier turn vs. current turn)

gaps.description: Information or questions the agent has not addressed

recommended_challenges.description: Questions the agent should ask back to break the agreement streak constructively

verdict.description: Overall judgment on whether the streak that triggered this eval was substantively warranted

signature.description: Optional HMAC signature for eval injection defense (Threat T02-3)
